metadata.name: GPU-T
metadata.summary: View detailed graphics card hardware specifications, capabilities, and real-time telemetry

content.value: GPU-T is a modern graphics card diagnostic and information utility for Linux built with .NET and Avalonia UI. Inspired by GPU-Z, it interacts directly with the Linux kernel (sysfs), graphics APIs, and hardware databases to deliver an information-dense overview of your video card and GPU.

Designed as a single source of truth for graphics hardware, the utility reports low-level silicon specifications, tracks real-time sensor readings, and inspects graphics capabilities across both AMD and NVIDIA hardware.

items.value: Identify GPU model, silicon revision, die size, transistor count, BIOS version, and release date
Monitor live clock speeds, hotspot and edge temperatures, fan speeds, and board power draw with file logging support
Verify PCIe Resizable BAR status, memory type, bus width, and driver versions
Inspect Vulkan extensions, OpenCL capabilities, and ray tracing support
Examine VA-API video decode and encode profiles on AMD GPUs, as well as CUDA and NVENC/NVDEC on NVIDIA hardware
